dispositions.reachability: Reachable only in the optional Expo/React Native peer closure at Metro build time: metro@0.84.4 calls image-size on application asset bytes. @expo/snapback-expo neither imports image-size nor parses image assets at runtime. A malicious ICNS build asset can therefore stall a developer build, but not a running Snapback client or server.
dispositions.upstreamStatus: No patched image-size release exists: 2.0.2 is the newest published version and the advisory covers every published version through 2.0.2. Metro 0.84.4 requires ^1.0.2, so forcing the 2.x API would also violate its declared range without removing the advisory.
dispositions.action: Track image-size and Metro for a compatible patched release; remove this disposition and lock the patched version by 2026-09-08.

dispositions.reachability: Not reachable through the locked parent: xcode@3.0.1 calls only uuid.v4() with no caller-supplied buffer, while the advisory is limited to v3/v5/v6 calls that receive a supplied buffer.
dispositions.upstreamStatus: uuid is patched in 11.1.1, but xcode@3.0.1 is the newest published xcode release and declares uuid ^7.0.3. An override to 11.1.1 would cross four unsupported major versions in a published Expo config-plugin closure.
dispositions.action: Track xcode/Expo for a compatible uuid range; remove this disposition and lock uuid >=11.1.1 by 2026-09-08.
